name: official-order-notifier
description: Posts new orders and status changes, and (as a notification channel: channels = ["plugin:official-order-notifier"]) any notification such as admin logins and lockouts, to a Slack incoming webhook or any JSON webhook. Set webhook_url in [plugins.settings.official-order-notifier] and list the webhook's domain in allowed_domains.
author: AegisCMS Core Team
